content.title: Chazadi 'Chit-Chat' Wright - Women's Basketball 2025-26
content.text: 2025-26- Recorded a career-high 24 points against Nebraska (1/1).- Grabbed a career-high seven rebounds against USC (1/29).- Dished out a career-high 12 assists against Minnesota (2/5).- Netted a career-high eight field goals against Virginia (3/23) in the Second Round of the NCAA Tournament.- Notched five games with 20+ points which was second-most on the team.- Recorded a total of 387 points, 138 assists and 93 rebounds.- Wright's 138 assists rank seventh on Iowa's sophomore single season list.- Earned All-Big Ten third team (coaches) and honorable mention (media).- Letter winner. 2024-25 (GEORGIA TECH)- Appeared in all 33 games with 12 starts.- Finished with 10 games in double-figures, averaging 7.2 points and 2.2 rebounds per game.- Scored a career-high 16 points, making four 3s, while adding two steals and an assist against Pittsburgh.- Earned first collegiate start at No. 3 Notre Dame, contributing 10 points and team-high five assists.HIGH SCHOOL- Multi-sport athlete at Wesleyan School, competing in basketball and track- Four-star recruit by ESPN HoopGurlz- Helped Wesleyan School to pair of regional championships (2021-22, 2023-24)- Two-time all-state honoree by the AJC, earning first-team 3A all-state in 2023 and first-team Class A Private all-state in 2022- Named Region 7 Class 3A Region Player of the Year…GBCA All-Star in 2021 and 2023Surpassed 1,000-career points as a junior in 2021-22 season- Served three years a basketball team captain- Competed one season in track, participating in the long jump, 100m dash, 4×1 and 4×4…won track state championship…recipient of the Kathy Benson Faculty CupPERSONAL- Majoring in business administration
